name: FC/ZFC/LTC remanence, AC susceptibility and low-temperature hysteresis (5-300 K, 5 T SIRM) of gas-hydrate-bearing sediments from IODP Site U1519C on an MPMS XL-7
plain_name: Read the magnetic minerals in deeply buried gas-hydrate mud between 5 K and room temperature
description: Thirteen sediment samples from 587-618 mbsf are given a 5 T SIRM (field-cooled, zero-field-cooled and room-temperature low-temperature-cycling protocols) and measured between 5 and 300 K; a subset gets AC susceptibility (1, 10, 111 Hz) and hysteresis loops at 5, 70, 130 and 300 K to +/-1 T, to identify magnetite and iron sulfides.
keywords: Read the magnetic minerals in deeply buried gas-hydrate mud between 5 K and room temperature

sources.citation: Liu, Li and Xu (2025) Low-temperature magnetic properties of deeply buried gas hydrate bearing sediments: a case study from IODP expedition 375 site U1519C in the Hikurangi subduction zone, New Zealand, Frontiers in Earth Science

requirements.rationale: All protocols cool to 5 K and warm back to 300 K.
The lowest measurement temperature is 5 K.
SIRM is imparted in a 5 T field.
AC susceptibility at 1-111 Hz was measured on a subset of nine samples.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
